correctness.rationale: The exact 17-state witness is specified by 15 rational interior probabilities. A cofactor/continuant proof of Q(s) gives derivative sign opposite to W(s²); four exact Fraction evaluations yield +,-,+,- at 3/5,3/4,19/20,1. Positivity of discounted continuants makes derivative signs valid for all s, and continuity/analyticity forces 3 distinct strict local extrema. Two exact independent resolvent evaluations cross-check the quotient. Numerical root location is not a proof ingredient.

value.rationale: A nontrivial, precisely motivated existence boundary for the explicitly stated multiple-optima question in Newton–Vega Coso §10.3. Three alternating strict interior extrema in one fixed, simple nearest-neighbor path exceed accessible prior one/two-extremum witnesses and illustrate geometric-reset complexity; the finite size and rigid rational sign certificate make the example reusable.
